channel.title: Israel National News Flashes

item.title: Trump tells troops victory over Iran is at hand, questions Tehran's willingness to deal
item.description: In a Thanksgiving address to deployed US troops, Trump declares victory over Iran is within reach but questions whether Tehran will seize the chance for a deal.

item.title: Board of Peace official: We expect Israel to translate its commitments into action
item.description:
A Board of Peace official expressed encouragement over recent discussions with the Prime Minister's Office and Israel's commitment to US President Donald Trump's 20-point plan.
"The Board expects Israel to translate these words into action in the coming days," the official said, according to a report by Ynet.

item.title: Rabbi Eliezer HaCohen Breuer, a longtime Temple Mount visitor, dies
item.description: Rabbi Eliezer HaCohen Breuer, a Soviet immigrant who championed Jewish settlement and holy sites, has died. For years, he took the first bus to the Temple Mount at 5 a.m. When daily trips became difficult, he decided to move to Jerusalem.

item.title: Mansour Abbas issues ultimatum to Eisenkot: "We will not sit idly by"
item.description: Ra'am chairman Mansour Abbas told opposition bloc leaders his party would not abstain in a vote to form a government. He said Ra'am would support an Eisenkot-led government only if its demands were met; otherwise, it would vote against it.

item.title: "Dad, something is missing from my body": Moshe Adika's recovery and mission after injury
item.description: Moshe Adika was seriously wounded by a bomb on reserve duty. After 9½ hours of surgery, he thought he had lost an arm. In an interview, he discusses his injury, PTSD, return to reserve duty and initiatives he founded for wounded IDF soldiers.
